insight: Built as an emotionally intelligent companion by Inflection AI; in March 2024 Microsoft acqui-hired most of the team, yet it stays free.
name: Pi
tagline: A free, emotionally intelligent personal AI for supportive conversation.
description: Pi (short for 'personal intelligence') is a conversational AI from Inflection AI designed for supportive, reflective dialogue rather than task automation. It emphasizes sustained, empathetic conversation across web, mobile, and voice, and is free to use without a subscription.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on Inflection's own in-house models.
